params.name: page_size
params.description: Filter for number of transfer objects to be included on each page

params.name: to_participant_code
params.description: Filter for `to_participant_code` in receipt of the transfer

params.name: from_participant_code
params.description: Filter for `from_participant_code` the transfer was sent from

params.name: requested_timestamp[gt]
params.description: Filter for greater than a given timestamp

params.name: requested_timestamp[gte]
params.description: Filter for greater than or equal to a given timestamp

params.name: requested_timestamp[e]
params.description: Filter for equal to a given timestamp

params.name: requested_timestamp[lt]
params.description: Filter for less than a given timestamp

params.name: requested_timestamp[lte]
params.description: Filter for less than or equal to a given timestamp

params.name: client_transfer_id
params.description: Filter for `client_transfer_id` associated with the transfer

params.name: from_account_group
params.description: Filter by the source account group of the transfer.

params.name: from_account_label
params.description: Filter by the source account label of the transfer.

params.name: to_account_group
params.description: Filter by the destination account group of the transfer.

params.name: to_account_label
params.description: Filter by the destination account label of the transfer.

params.name: currency
params.description: Filter by the asset code of the transfer, e.g. `USD`.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of objects containing information about transfers. This endpoint supports pagination and filtering based on the below parameters. Results are limited to the last 2 months.

Create a new transfer request between your own accounts.
To submit transfers on behalf of others, you will require the `submits_platform_transfers_for` relationship. Transfer requests created via the API are automatically set to an `APPROVED` state.

params.name: id
params.description: Filter for id assigned to a transfer request

items.docs: Retrieves a single transfer made to or from your participant, or to or from your platform's account group.
